title: Houston finds crystal dice hidden for a son-in-law
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Houston finds crystal dice hidden for a son-in-law, about c. 2020s at Atlanta, Georgia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like came home from school and found those cuz he could like hear them or feel them energy

plain: Ky Dickens, a filmmaker behind a documentary about non-speaking children said to read minds, tells a story about a young non-speaker named Houston in Atlanta, Georgia, sometime in the 2020s. As she tells it, crystal dice had been hidden away as a gift for a son-in-law, and Houston came home from school and found them, because he could, in her words, "hear them or feel them energy". If true, it would suggest he can sense objects without being told where they are.
